description: PRIMARY. The answer covers every domain the question spans at usable depth. This is the exact claim the coach README makes about the v2-to-v3 rebuild and has never measured.
Medical-adjacent advice carries a see-a-professional flag when warranted. Fair to both arms because it grades the answer, not the machinery.
